hero.title: 19 Years Focused on Intelligent Manufacturing
hero.leadHtml: Guangdong TXAM Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. (abbreviated as "TXAM"), originated in 1998, officially established in 2007 in Shenzhen, a national technology hub. We have always adhered to our corporate philosophy of Dedication, Steady Development, Reputation First, Quality Supreme, committed to providing world-class enterprises with one-stop delivery services for intelligent equipment.

timeline.title: Development History
timeline.subtitle: A steady and step-by-step evolution of intelligent manufacturing.

events.bodyHtml: The technical team prototype was born. In 2007, 'Guangdong TXAM Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.' was officially registered in Shenzhen, embarking on the exploration and intelligent manufacturing journey of non-standard automation production lines.
events.mobileBody: Officially registered 'Guangdong TXAM', embarking on the intelligent manufacturing journey of non-standard automation production lines.

events.bodyHtml: The business landscape expanded comprehensively. With outstanding quality, we officially became a core intelligent manufacturing supplier for major home appliance and commercial display leaders such as TCL, Skyworth, Midea, Konka, and Changhong, establishing a leading position in the industry.
events.mobileBody: Became a core supplier for major enterprises such as TCL, Skyworth, Midea, Konka, and Changhong.

events.bodyHtml: Established a new energy intelligent equipment R&D team, debuting core equipment such as the self-developed 'circulating automatic elevator' at the CIBF international battery exhibition, fully entering the new energy and three-dimensional warehousing logistics track.
events.mobileBody: Established a new energy equipment R&D team, debuting core equipment at the CIBF battery exhibition.

events.leadHtml: The 100,000 m² Shenzhen-Huizhou dual-base layout was fully formed.
events.bodyHtml: Self-developed core technologies such as UVW platform calibration and large-screen lifting obtained 98 patents, with equipment exported to 15 countries and regions including North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia.
events.mobileBody: 100,000 m² Shenzhen-Huizhou dual-base layout formed, obtained 98 patents, equipment exported to 15 countries.
